main_text.l: Muham-medanorum, eaque in primis quæ in Per-
side à Doctoribus illius gentis de hoc ne-
gotio didicerat; accepit etiam à Vallæo
tum & alia nonnulla, quæ ad sermonem
tione ideò Morinus tenebatur, quòd in
gentis illius Religione, Moribus, illius li-
cteres[?] esse fusius probat, & de illorum si-
clis, quorum nonnullos profert, variè dif-
ferit; statim ab initio operis in eo pec-
in usum suum Linguâ Græcâ donatum
fuisse, cùm longè verisimilius sit ab ipsis

page.notes: Running head "VITA" is set in spaced capitals, as printed. The word "hunc" on the line "tunc delitesceret" is partly obscured; the first letter is uncertain. "cteres" at the start of the line after "chara-" has a damaged first letter; likely a ligature or a damaged "a" or "h", read as cteres[?]. The footnote mark (i) is in parentheses in the text. The right edge of the scan is damaged and shadowed, but no text is lost there. Printed spacing irregularities ("deChronologia", "Religione,Moribus") are left as printed.
